description: MainActivity.java for an Android application that manages high-bandwidth network connectivity on Wear OS devices. The file contains code to request, monitor, and release high-bandwidth networks, primarily Wi-Fi, with UI handling and network callback management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing network connectivity, UI updates, and user interactions related to high-bandwidth network requests on Wear OS.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and network management callbacks.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases high-bandwidth network resources when activity stops.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks network status and updates UI when activity resumes.

methods.name: unregisterNetworkCallback
methods.description: Unregisters the network callback to stop listening for network changes.

methods.name: isNetworkHighBandwidth
methods.description: Checks if a high-bandwidth network is available based on the current network capabilities.

methods.name: requestHighBandwidthNetwork
methods.description: Requests the system to establish a high-bandwidth network connection with specified capabilities.

methods.name: releaseHighBandwidthNetwork
methods.description: Releases the current high-bandwidth network binding.

methods.name: addWifiNetwork
methods.description: Starts activity to add a Wi-Fi network manually.

methods.name: onButtonClick
methods.description: Handles user interaction with the UI button, triggering network requests, releases, or Wi-Fi addition.

methods.name: setUiState
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on the current network state.
